 The Institute for Child Health Policy (ICHP) at the University of Florida is seeking a Data Scientist IV to join its leadership team. Ensure rigorous data transformation, quality assurance, and reproducibility of analytic workflows. Interpret findings within the context of Medicaid policy and healthcare delivery systems.
   

  

**Scientific Reporting and Policy Integration:** 
 Interpret and apply state and federal regulations relevant to assigned projects, identifying policy implications based on research findings and integrating recommendations into descriptive and technical reports. Demonstrate exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to independently author technical documentation, methodological appendices, analytic summaries, and executive\-level briefings. Drive strategic initiatives, lead enterprise change management efforts, and foster collaborations with external stakeholders within the Medicaid agency.

 Participate in recruitment, training, supervision, and mentorship of analytic staff.  Support drafting budgets, data use agreements, and other project\-related duties as assigned.
